note: Eritrea: Kenyans and Ugandans enter without a visa for an indefinite stay; Ethiopians get a 30-day visa on arrival and Sudanese one with no set limit; everyone else needs a visa from a mission (or a pre-arranged visa collected on arrival through a sponsor: taken as a visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Eritrea
sources.said: Visitors to Eritrea must obtain a visa from one of the Eritrean diplomatic missions , unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries or countries eligible for visa on arrival. ... Citizens of Kenya and Uganda can visit Eritrea without a visa for an indefinite period of stay. ... Citizens of the following countries may obtain a visa on arrival for Eritrea: Ethiopia (30 days) Sudan (Indefinite Stay)
